mode: locally adapted copies; reviewed manual updates
adaptations: Repository instructions and docs/agents/skills.md are shared context; no global installation or application dependencies.
Debugging starts with user-facing E2E reproduction; removes bash helper and active-checkout bisection requirements.
TDD uses established test interfaces without repeated confirmation and reviews refactoring locally without a code-review skill dependency.
Design vocabulary preserves project terminology; test replacement retains meaningful coverage.
Architecture interview and domain discussion are self-contained; grilling and domain-modeling are not required.
Architecture report is offline HTML/CSS/SVG instead of CDN Tailwind/Mermaid.
Architecture upstream explicit-only behavior is represented by agents/openai.yaml.
Delegation requires a user request and remains in the existing checkout; alternative designs can be explored sequentially.
Markdown uses plain dashes and one sentence per line.
